newsitem.title: USA: Dow sets record; ends above 7,200 for first time.
newsitem.headline: Dow sets record; ends above 7,200 for first time.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average raced into record territory Monday, closing above 7,200 points for the first time on hopes that an agreement on balancing the federal budget would keep the Federal Reserve from raising interest rates later this month.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow was up 143.29 points, or 2.03 percent, to close at 7,214.49, its 16th record finish so far this year.
In the broader market, advancing issues swamped declines by a huge 3-to-1 margin on heavy volume of 551 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
